execution.description: Recorded the owner-approved top-rung grant for battery Level 1+ and wired its start rung, lowest level and token share.

expected: Raising the run cost by the approved USD 10 model allowance lets a kimi-k3 Constructor run.
observed: A full-window kimi-k3 call reserves USD 2.0646912, more than a Level 0 run's USD 1.95 token share, so a run on the old split would stop before its first call. The token share had to be registered with the grant (USD 11.93, five full reservations) and checked against a real scripted session, not inferred from the run cost. The brief's estimate of about USD 3.30 per call did not match the code's settings.
keep: Derive a model grant from the role's real selection (`roles.MODEL_SETTINGS`) and test a full-window call's admission end to end.
Bind a model-tier condition to the grant registry so every other grant stays byte-identical.
change: State a grant's token share explicitly whenever the model rung differs from the one its sibling grant was sized for.
